## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`os package install` 的服务器参数从 `-r/--runtime` 改名为 `-u/--url`(无别名),并新增 `-t/--token`,与 `os package export` 等命令写法一致;打开无权访问的应用、仪表盘、列表视图时,403 拒绝文案改为按调用者语言输出(中文控制台显示「您没有执行此操作的权限，如需访问请联系管理员。」)。
- 为什么改:#30126 第 13 行(裁决 A:统一服务器与凭据写法)和第 12 行(Setup 应用拒绝文案是英文,还带着 `com.objectstack.setup` 这种 API 名)。
- 风险与回滚:破坏性变更,只影响传 `-r`/`--runtime` 的脚本,会被当作未知参数拒绝;只设 `OS_RUNTIME_URL` 的脚本不受影响。拒绝文案不再含条目名,两条 #8013 断言随之改写,请在合约评审中确认。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts` 的 `url` / `token` 参数;`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` 的 `permissionDeniedMessage`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/package-install-url-token-flags.test.ts`(8 条全绿);`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-permission-refusal-locale.test.ts`(9 条全绿)。
- 需要你做的:标题带 `!`,入队前需要你对本 PR 点头,并完成合约评审(收窄面)。落地由席位负责。

## What changes

- **Row 13, `@objectstack/cli` (BREAKING).** `os package install` names its server `-u, --url` (env `OS_RUNTIME_URL`, default `http://localhost:3000`, both unchanged) in place of `-r, --runtime`, with no alias. A script that passes `-r` or `--runtime` is refused as an unknown flag. A new `-t, --token` (env `OS_RUNTIME_TOKEN`) sends a token the target runtime issued as `Authorization: Bearer` on the install request, with no sign-in round trip; `--email` / `--password` still work. Passing a token together with `--email` / `--password` is refused before any request. These are the spellings `os package export` and about twenty other server-talking commands use. `packages/cli` has no shared flag helper to reuse, so the two flags are declared inline with the same shape as `export`'s.
- **Docs and templates.** `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` (example, flag table, credential paragraph), `content/docs/deployment/publish-and-preview.mdx`, `packages/cli/README.md`, and the `create-objectstack` scaffold's `AGENTS.md` and blank `README.md` now say `--url`. The scaffold's two lines were outside the claimed surface but would have become false, so they are fixed here, with a `create-objectstack` patch in the changeset.
- **Row 12, `@objectstack/rest`.** The `/meta` read gate's three `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` refusals (app, dashboard, list view) rendered fixed English sentences naming the item's API name. They now render the operation catalog's `permission_denied` (`renderOperationMessage`, `@objectstack/spec/system`) in the caller's `ExecutionContext.locale`. That is the catalog and key plugin-security's object and capability refusals already use. The REST door also hands in the `errors.*` override lookup, so a deployment's `errors.permission_denied` translation applies here as it does there. The runtime dispatcher calls the same gate and gets the built-in catalog in the caller's locale; it hands no override lookup, because `packages/runtime` is outside this claim. Status, code and envelope are unchanged.

## Tests

- `packages/cli/test/package-install-url-token-flags.test.ts` (new, 8): `--url` / `-u` reach the request URL; `--runtime` and `-r` are refused before any request; `--token`, `-t` and `OS_RUNTIME_TOKEN` send `Authorization: Bearer`; no token sends no header; token plus email/password is refused with exit 1 before any request.
- Sixteen existing CLI test files pass `--url` where they passed `--runtime`, including seven integration files that spawn the CLI.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-permission-refusal-locale.test.ts` (new, 9): a `zh-CN` caller reads the Chinese sentence on all three refusals; a caller with no locale reads the English one, which carries no API name; a deployment override wins; a lookup that echoes the key is no override; a lookup that throws keeps the built-in sentence and the 403.
- `meta-app-publish-gate.test.ts` and `meta-item-absent-404.test.ts`: the two #8013 assertions `message toContain('finance')` now assert the catalog sentence. Status and code assertions are unchanged.
- Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored with blob == HEAD: the token/email refusal guard disabled → 1 of 8 failed; the locale dropped from `renderOperationMessage` → 6 of 9 failed.

## Acceptance notes

- **The refusal no longer names the item.** The `permission_denied` key takes no placeholders on purpose (`operation-message.ts`), and the name the gate had was the API name (`com.objectstack.setup`), which is what row 12 reported. Keeping a name would need a new catalog key in `packages/spec`, which this claim forbids. The Console's "You don't have access" page shows the server sentence (`ui/packages/app-shell` CHANGELOG notes it named the item); it now shows the localized sentence. This is the point for the contract review to confirm.
- `createMetaItemReadGate`'s `name` parameter is now read by no gate. It is kept (as `_name`) so neither transport's call changes.
- Row 9: ruling A, no change. Row 16: ruling A, filed by the seat as its own card.

## Out of scope

- `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md:106` still says `--runtime` for `os package install`. The seat files it as a skills-lane card, serial behind this PR.
